name: Rally Raid Repair
description: Rally repair menu for Rally Raid stages (Ctrl+Shift+F): mid-stage wheel change, light suspension and radiator repairs (time added to the stage), whole-car repair and engine change at the bivouac (3 h budget), spare wheels and resets left, RECOVER CAR (Ctrl+Shift+G, the one reset allowed in a stage) and resuming a stage saved before a game crash (Ctrl+Shift+H).
author: Rally Raid for BeamNG.Earth
